scripts.dev: turbo run build --filter=./packages/* && turbo run dev --concurrency=12
scripts.dev:portfolio: turbo run build --filter="@portfolio/portfolio^..." && turbo run dev --concurrency=12 --filter=@portfolio/portfolio...
scripts.dev:editor: turbo run build --filter="@portfolio/editor^..." && turbo run dev --concurrency=12 --filter=@portfolio/editor...
scripts.build: pnpm check:boundaries && turbo run build --concurrency=1 && node tools/checks/artifacts.mjs
scripts.build:portfolio: pnpm check:boundaries && turbo run build --concurrency=1 --filter=@portfolio/portfolio... && node tools/checks/artifacts.mjs portfolio
scripts.build:editor: pnpm check:boundaries && turbo run build --concurrency=1 --filter=@portfolio/editor... && node tools/checks/artifacts.mjs editor
scripts.check:boundaries: node tools/checks/boundaries.mjs && depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type err apps/portfolio/src apps/editor/src packages
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check:no-empty-tests && pnpm build && pnpm test:smoke
